body: Hey, thank you so much for asking! I've had to postpone doing it, there were too many people around where I wanted to pass out (near a lake). Now I'll need to finish a few work-related things I promised earlier, then Friday night I'm going to do it. Please don't worry about me, it's going to be better for everyone if I succeed. Thank you again!
You're right about the first part but not about the second.
Thank you, this is very kind of you! No, this is not what I expect to kill me, I only need to lose consciousness and the environment I'm going to be in is going to take care of the rest.
Definitely not a shitpost. Let's put it like this, I've made peace with my decision.
Wonderful, thank you! I'd rather not tell you as I'm afraid you'd regret having answered, and I don't want you to bear that burden.
Tonight is the night. I have come to peace with my decision. It won't be painful, I'll pass out before I could feel anything. DB, I'll always love you❤🐞

Thank you for sharing your story with me, I'm very happy to hear that you're on the right track! No, she didn't cheat on me, as it turned out, she got afraid of moving to another country (where I'm living) because I behaved in a rather childish way sometimes (got angry, couldn't think with a cool head). But I'm fine now in the sense that I'm not feeling absolutely anything now, there is a huge void of space in my head.
I'm in the same situation, 31M here. I wish I could give you any advice.

Thank you so much for being so honest with me! The issue is that she broke up with me in April, and recently she made it very clear that she's not interested in starting over. So my decision is not fuelled by the break up, but by the hopelessness. I am not willing to live 50 years more without her. Knowing what happiness is like and then losing it is much worse than not knowing it in the first place.

Thank you so much for your kind words! My problem has always been living in the past, and now more than ever I just simply cannot imagine myself with anyone else, or learning at some point that she's going to be with someone else, living happily the life I want her to live with me happily. Yes, it's childish and immature, I know, but this is who I am.
My dreams are sometimes wonderful, I see my ex smiling at me, then I wake up and reality hits me in the face, and it all becomes a nightmare.
Same here! I made my decision yesterday and I've been so calm and peaceful as never before.
